title: RRB NTPC Syllabus 2026 – CBT 1 & CBT 2
vacancyDetails: CBT-1 common; CBT-2 level-wise; Typing/CBAT for specific posts
qualification: 12th / Graduation as per post level in CEN
ageLimit: As per RRB NTPC CEN (relaxations apply)
selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → Typing Skill Test / CBAT (post-wise) → DV → Medical
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF; keep notification for pattern updates
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in or rrbapply.gov.in
2. Open relevant NTPC CEN
3. Download syllabus annexure for CBT-1/CBT-2
4. Prepare Maths, Reasoning, General Awareness
5. Practice speed for CBT and typing if required
shortDescription: RRB NTPC Syllabus – CBT-1 & CBT-2 subjects: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness.
content:
RRB NTPC Computer Based Tests cover three core areas at different difficulty for CBT-1 and CBT-2.

CBT-1 (common pattern – indicative)

  • General Awareness
  • Mathematics
  • General Intelligence and Reasoning

Objective MCQs with negative marking (typically 1/3rd). Duration and number of questions as per CEN.

CBT-2

Same three subjects with higher difficulty and more questions for Graduate / Under-Graduate pay levels. Separate CBTs may run for different pay levels.

Topic highlights

  • Maths: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals, LCM-HCF, Ratio, Percentage, Mensuration, Time-Work, SI-CI, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, DI
  • Reasoning: Analogies, Coding, Series, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn, Data sufficiency, Maps, Graphs
  • GA: Current affairs, Science & Tech, Sports, Culture, History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Railways, Awards

Post-specific: Typing Skill Test / Computer Based Aptitude Test (for Station Master etc.). Official CEN PDF on RRB sites.
